findings.text: The mirror check was a no-op before, so every mirror passed. It is now enforced with the character class [a-zA-Z0-9./_-], which excludes ':', '@', '~', '%' and '+'. A valid mirror with a port, such as NVM_NODEJS_ORG_MIRROR=http://localhost:8080 or http://mirror.local:8000/dist, now fails with 'may only contain a URL' and returns 2. That breaks every nvm install and ls-remote for those users.
